findings.finding: The file's line text and its /tmp suffix had no verified source.
findings.answer: LINE is the Dispatch issue title verbatim (`dispatch read --issue LEGSMOKE-1195`, Title line) prefixed by `LEGSMOKE-1195: `, pinned as one quoted string with bytes=81 and sha256=49da57b0…c349 in plan constants; no phase re-derives it.

findings.finding: `wc -l` = 1 plus `head -1` cannot decide trailing newline, CR, BOM or byte count.
findings.answer: A1 is the full byte set at a named SHA via the raw contents API: wc -l = 1, wc -c = 81, last byte 0a via `od -An -tx1`, sha256sum = H, head -1 string-equals LINE.

findings.finding: 'On the branch's first push' is ambiguous: the branch exists at origin at main's tip and the planner's handoff push comes first.
findings.answer: Criteria bind to firstCodeHead, the SHA of the first push carrying the file, recorded once in implement.json; tester and reviewer read at that SHA, never at a branch name.

findings.finding: `gh pr diff --name-only` answers differently per phase as .legion/ handoffs accumulate and docs/solutions/ appears at retro.
findings.answer: A2 uses the compare API from forkPoint to the head under test with `.legion/` filtered inside the jq filter: exactly smoke/LEGSMOKE-1195.md (+1/−0) before retro, plus docs/solutions/ paths at the merging head; jq flags go inside the filter for the pane gh wrapper.

findings.finding: 'Workflows pass on the PR head' names no SHA and each push yields a push run and a pull_request run per job.
findings.answer: A3 reads `commits/<sha>/check-runs` at firstCodeHead and the approved head, requires `check` and `gate` completed/success, cites the pull_request pair and names the push pair; no `.fail-me` probe is ever created (no root .gitignore would snapshot it).

findings.answer: forkPoint F and branch tip B (both 6d843f28) are recorded; the 404 control is read at F and at main; pre-state is recorded as invalidating facts (404 at main, 0 commits by path, 0 PRs) with its time.

findings.finding: The post-merge criterion (main holds the file, no earlier commit contains it) had no owner or command.
findings.answer: A5 is assigned to the implementer's production check after the close: raw file at ?ref=main has sha256 = H (or the A4 two-line bytes) and `commits?path=…&sha=main` lists exactly the PR's merge commit; control: the same read at sha=forkPoint is empty.
